**Group members**: Nicole Lewis (nel239), Rezwana Habib (rfh2133), Emanuel Clemente (ejc2222), Helene Apollon (hca2124), Meher Walia (mw3952)

**Tentative Project Title**: Starred in the City: Exploring Michelin Dining in New York City 

**Intended final products**: Webpage and screen cast
We want to create an NYC restaurant guide to help an individual know the best restaurant option for them.The webpage will include graphs of restaurant locations, a screen cast, data sources.


Graph details: proximity/location, Michelin Star status, cuisine type, dietary restrictions, price, proximity to subway stations, review/rating, food/drink options, and type of seating for each restaurant. 

**Anticipated Data Sources**: We plan to use publicly available datasets on New York City restaurants, including the NYC Happy Hour Index which contains information on happy hour specials, pricing, neighborhood, and borough, and a Google Maps restaurant dataset containing information on restaurant names, locations, ratings, number of reviews, and price categories, and a Michelin Guide dataset, filtered to include 630 NYC locations, with information on restaurant locations, cuisine type and Michelin distinctions. We also plan to use an NYC subway entrance and exit dataset to assess restaurant accessibility based on proximity to subway stations, available subway lines, and estimated walking distances and times. Datasets are currently available in the project's data folder, and we plan to explore additional sources and supplement existing data with our own research as needed.
